title: Find K-th Smallest Pair Distance
summary: Define the distance between two integers a and b as |a - b|.
statement: Define the distance between two integers a and b as |a - b|. Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, determine the k-th smallest distance among all pairs of distinct elements in nums.
constraints: nums has at least two integers and k indexes the sorted multiset of all unordered-pair distances from one.
Repeated values and repeated distances count separately.
Return the kth smallest absolute distance.
reference_solution:
def kth_smallest_pair_distance(nums,k):
    nums=sorted(nums)
    def count(limit):
        total=left=0
        for right,value in enumerate(nums):
            while value-nums[left]>limit:left+=1
            total+=right-left
        return total
    low,high=0,nums[-1]-nums[0]
    while low<high:
        middle=(low+high)//2
        if count(middle)>=k:high=middle
        else:low=middle+1
    return low

hints: For a proposed distance d, count pairs no farther than d with a sliding left pointer.
That count is monotone in d.
Binary-search the first d whose count reaches k.
The lower-bound distance is exactly the kth value in the sorted distance multiset.
